needs_atom.missing: Declaration-level restriction 'can't attack or block alone' (CR 506.5): an attack (block) including this creature is legal only if at least one other creature is declared as an attacker (blocker) in the same declaration. The PREVENT_EFFECT over DeclareAttackersEvent/DeclareBlockersEvent shapes (Pirate's 'can't block', Gadrak's 'can't attack unless ...') judge each creature or a game-state condition, and neither event has a group-size slot (the engine's _group_size exists only for the BATTALION trigger); a plain 'can't attack or block' would be weaker than printed, dropping the clause stronger.
